description: Import and Export Control Department - Correction notice to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2143/36 of 03.10.2019, which published under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, specifically amending import license regulations and correcting printing errors in tariff schedules. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for import controls, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the regulatory content rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
